name: Language-Aware Images
description: TMDB images in your library's language with a clean fallback to English, no more textless posters.
overview: Drop-in replacement for the built-in TMDB image provider. Enforces a clean cascade: library language → English → (optional) textless. Within each bucket images are sorted by vote_count DESC like TMDB's own /images UI. Fixes jellyfin/jellyfin#9878 (built-in prefers textless over English fallback).
changelog: Episode title-match now runs for every episode, not just out-of-sync ones. The previous 'smart mode' returned empty for episodes whose title matched TMDB's position, deferring to the built-in provider. That made the language-aware entry disappear from the image picker for the common in-sync case. Now the plugin always returns the title-matched still tagged with the preferred language, so it ranks above the built-in's positional still in Jellyfin's image sort regardless of whether the library is in sync.
